description: Utility functions for managing tree structures in a drag-and-drop interface, including flattening, building, projecting, serializing, and counting folders and tree items within a Datasource Folders editor component.

methods.name: getDragDepth
methods.description: Calculates the depth of a dragged item based on drag offset and indentation width.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Determines the maximum allowed depth based on previous item.

methods.name: getMinDepth
methods.description: Determines the minimum allowed depth based on next item and active item.

methods.name: getProjection
methods.description: Projects the target depth and parent ID for a dragged tree item based on current drag position.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested tree structure into a list with depth and parent info.

methods.name: flattenTree
methods.description: Public function to flatten a tree of TreeItems.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a nested tree structure from a flattened list of items.

methods.name: removeChildrenOf
methods.description: Removes specified items and their children from a flattened list.

methods.name: serializeForAPI
methods.description: Serializes tree items into a format suitable for API transmission, excluding empty folders.

methods.name: countAllFolders
methods.description: Counts all folders, including nested subfolders, in a DatasourceFolder array.
